whatWasVerified.check: Would a specified atom-count scorer write absent from zero atoms
whatWasVerified.result: absence probe runs ONLY when parcel denominator is null (measure.ts:197). Atom count 0 with parcels present offers absence=null, so scoreRailCell writes not-yet (below threshold), not satisfied-absent. Not the presence-shaped zero-atoms=absent bug. Also not the sparse-rail source-table-zero path L7 doctrine named.
whatWasVerified.whatWouldProveWrong: measurement.absence set because numerator===0 while denominator>0.

whatWasVerified.result: STARVED PAIR. Parcel-level build*AbsenceAtom writes typed absence only (well-fact-writer.ts:169-172; rrc-pipeline-fact-writer.ts:213-216; rail-corridor-fact-writer.ts:170-173; special-district-fact-writer.ts:192-195). County-coverage builders write the pair (well-fact-writer.ts:211-214 and siblings). write-well-fact-county.mjs / write-rrc-pipeline-fact-county.mjs / write-rail-corridor-fact-county.mjs / write-special-district-fact-county.mjs never call the coverage builders. plan-county-well-facts.ts:161-168 emits per-parcel no-well-on-or-near, which becomes typed absence.
whatWasVerified.whatWouldProveWrong: A write-*-county.mjs call to buildCounty*CoverageAtom. Zero hits.

secondMechanismRejected.observation: well-fact / rrc-pipeline-fact / rail-corridor-fact writers export buildCounty*CoverageAbsenceAtom with evaluated true and provenanceScope
secondMechanismRejected.firstMechanism: The pair is starved on the apply path because write-*-county.mjs never calls those builders; parcel-level typed absence is what apply would persist
secondMechanismRejected.secondMechanism: The pair is already written in production and Q5e 0/1025 is a sampling miss
secondMechanismRejected.whyRejected: Q5e is TABLESAMPLE 0/1025 on verifiedAbsence, evaluated, and provenanceScope independently (R-07 grade). Sampling miss of a widely written field at that rate is the less likely mechanism. Independently, the write scripts contain zero calls. Code reading outranks output measuring; the write path was read.
